notes: RBox contraction paired with history-replace-0012: removes the original inverse, 'preceded' for 'succeeded'. Every query becomes 'I don't know', including the three propositional ones (strong Kleene). The instance prompts say 'Given only this' (Edward VII and Victoria; Louis XVI and Louis XV) and ask the converse in the original relation. Near and far unrelated queries are the revision's (near exempt from Rule 7).
